systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Forward-Osmosis MVR Concentration Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Hybrid Membrane & Mechanical Vapor Recompression Skid (ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 1 & 2 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 60-01 & 45-03 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.technology: Hollow-Fiber Thin-Film Composite (TFC) Forward-Osmosis Membrane Train coupled with Single-Stage Centrifugal Turbo-Compressor Falling-Film Evaporator Calandria
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm) with Titanium Grade 2 Heat Exchanger Plate Cassettes & Duplex Stainless Steel 2205 Compressor Casing
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: ASME UV Certified Vacuum Break Valves, Dual Rupture Discs, Compressor Vibration Monitoring (ISO 10816-3 Class II), and Acoustic Attenuation Enclosure (< 78 dBA)
systemArchitectures.description: State-of-the-art continuous clean concentration skid for heat-sensitive food, beverage, and dairy streams. Forward osmosis dewaters incoming feeds against a thermolytic or engineered draw solute at ambient temperatures without hydraulic pressure fouling, while a high-efficiency MVR calandria re-concentrates the draw solution at 52°C, re-compressing evaporated steam to achieve ultra-low specific energy consumption (< 15 kWh/ton H2O).

systemArchitectures.name: Aseptic Dairy Whey & Native Protein FO-MVR Concentrator
systemArchitectures.classification: Dairy Processing Sanitary Evaporator Skid (USDA Dairy / 3-A 60-01 / FDA 21 CFR § 131)
systemArchitectures.technology: Multi-Stage Spiral-Wound FO Membrane Cartridges paired with High-Speed Centrifugal Turbocompressor and Low-Shear Falling Film Calandria
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L Contact Surfaces with Laser-Welded Falling Film Pillow Plates and FDA-Compliant EPDM/PTFE Sanitary Seals
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Automatic CIP Pressure Interlocks, Condensate Conductivity Leak Probes, and Surge Line Blow-Off Diverter
systemArchitectures.description: Specialized dairy dewatering skid designed to concentrate sweet and acid whey from 6% to 65% total solids without thermal protein denaturation, lactosylation, or calcium phosphate fouling on vacuum calandria surfaces.

systemArchitectures.name: High-Vacuum Cold-Essence FO-MVR Concentrator
systemArchitectures.classification: Non-Thermal Aseptic Botanical Juice Concentrator (FDA 21 CFR § 120 HACCP / EHEDG Cleanability)
systemArchitectures.technology: Aquaporin-Inside Biomimetic Hollow-Fiber FO Membranes coupled with Twin-Screw Positive-Displacement Vapor Compressor operating at Deep Vacuum (0.18 bar)
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Monolithic Solid Hastelloy C-22 Product Passes with PTFE-Lined Draw Manifolds and Dual Mechanical Shaft Seals with Barrier Fluid
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Triple-Redundant Vacuum Sensors, In-Line Turbidimeters for Membrane Rupture Detection, and Automatic N2 Blanket Isolator
systemArchitectures.description: Premier aroma-preservation system for single-strength orange, berry, and botanical extracts. Captures 99.8% of volatile terpenes (limonene, linalool) and phenolic antioxidants by maintaining low evaporation temperatures (42°C) without strip-down losses.

systemArchitectures.name: Cleanroom Modular Pilot FO-MVR Research Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Pilot Membrane-MVR Validation Unit (ISO Class 5 Cleanroom / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.technology: Flexible Multi-Tube FO Test Cassette with Variable-Speed Magnetic-Drive MVR Turbo-Compressor and Sight-Glass Falling Film Column
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: AISI 316L Passivated Surfaces with Borosilicate 3.3 Glass Observation Windows and PEEK Impeller Turbines
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Class 1 Div 2 Explosion-Proof Rating, Programmable PLC Auto-Emergency Stop, and Overheat Calandria Cutoff
systemArchitectures.description: Scalable validation skid for R&D laboratories, food technology universities, and novel bioprocessing pilot facilities optimizing osmotic membrane fluxes and vapor compressor compression ratios across diverse feedstocks.

feedMatrices.name: Sweet & Acid Dairy Whey Permeate (6.0% Initial Total Solids)
feedMatrices.description: High-volume dairy byproduct rich in lactose, beta-lactoglobulin, and alpha-lactalbumin. FO pre-concentration removes 75% of water at ambient temp without hydraulic compaction, while low-temperature MVR finishes to 65% Brix without protein gelling or Maillard brown discoloration.

feedMatrices.name: Cold-Pressed Valencia Orange & Tangerine Juice (10.5°Brix)
feedMatrices.description: Aroma-delicate citrus juice containing heat-labile ascorbic acid, pectin, and d-limonene top-notes. Operating at 44°C avoids cooked jammy off-flavors, preserving the fresh sensory profile of squeezed fruit with near-zero volatile loss.

feedMatrices.name: Specialty Cold-Brew Arabica Coffee & Botanical Extract (4.5°Brix)
feedMatrices.description: Premium cold-water coffee extraction rich in fragile floral pyrazines, aldehydes, and chlorogenic acids. Concentrated under deep vacuum without flash evaporation strip-down, delivering barista-grade clean flavor upon reconstitution.

feedMatrices.name: Probiotic L. rhamnosus & Recombinant Enzyme Fermentation Broth (3.2°Brix)
feedMatrices.description: Live bacterial cell suspensions and therapeutic biocatalytic enzymes. FO-MVR dewatering at 40°C maintains > 98.8% live CFU viability and 99.4% enzymatic specific activity by avoiding thermal cell lysis and shear vortex breakdown.

feedMatrices.name: Upcycled Brewer's Spent Grain & Pea Starch Hydrolysate (8.0°Brix)
feedMatrices.description: Complex circular economy carbohydrate-protein streams with high suspended solids and polyphenols. Resists severe membrane foulant cake formation through osmotic backwash and low-viscosity turbulent crossflow.

membraneDrawSolutes.name: Thermolytic Ammonium Bicarbonate (NH4HCO3) Engineered Draw Solute
membraneDrawSolutes.description: Decomposes into NH3 and CO2 gas at mild temperatures (55–60°C), which are captured in the MVR vapor phase and re-absorbed into pure recycled draw solution with zero residual salt taste in the product.

membraneDrawSolutes.name: Food-Grade Magnesium Sulfate (MgSO4) / Potassium Lactate Draw
membraneDrawSolutes.description: Non-volatile, GRAS-certified osmotic draw solution optimized for falling-film MVR evaporators. High osmotic driving force enables rapid dewatering up to 68°Brix with imperceptible reverse diffusion (< 0.1 g/m²·h).

membraneDrawSolutes.name: Aquaporin Biomimetic TFC Hollow-Fiber Module with Switchable Solute
membraneDrawSolutes.description: State-of-the-art membrane integrating biological water-channel proteins (aquaporin Z) into thin-film polymer sheets. Exceptional pure-water flux (J_w > 35 LMH) with 100% rejection of flavor volatiles and zero salt leakage.

membraneDrawSolutes.name: Conventional High-Temperature Single-Effect Vacuum Pan (Hazardous / Ineffective Control)
membraneDrawSolutes.description: Obsolete steam-boiler thermal pan relying on 90–100°C wall temperatures. Destroys 45% of flavor volatiles, induces severe Maillard browning and calandria fouling, and consumes > 650 kWh/ton of thermal energy.

mvrCompressorStages.name: High-Efficiency Centrifugal Vapor Turbocompressor Stage
mvrCompressorStages.description: Titanium-impeller turbocompressor operating at 24,000 RPM. Active magnetic levitation guarantees 100% oil-free vapor contact, zero lubricant contamination into clean condensate, and exceptional thermodynamic COP (> 30).

mvrCompressorStages.name: Twin-Screw Sanitary Positive-Displacement Vapor Compressor
mvrCompressorStages.bearingType: Ceramic Hybrid Bearings with Aseptic Seals
mvrCompressorStages.description: Robust positive-displacement recompressor capable of handling liquid droplet entrainment and variable suction pressures without surging. Delivers high single-stage temperature lifts (ΔT up to 14°C) for viscous syrups.

mvrCompressorStages.name: Multi-Stage Direct-Drive Turbo-Fan MVR Booster Train
mvrCompressorStages.description: Ultra-low-energy direct-drive multi-wheel fan train designed for large volumetric vapor flows. Maximizes isentropic efficiency for low-Brix initial dewatering with minimum specific electricity draw.

mvrCompressorStages.name: Uncompressed Live Boiler Steam Sparger (Hazardous / Ineffective Control)
mvrCompressorStages.description: Rejects vapor directly to atmosphere and requires massive quantities of fresh high-pressure fossil boiler steam. Generates massive thermal pollution, high carbon emissions, and deafening acoustic noise (> 94 dBA).
